content.user_title: Create Premium Google Stitch Design Systems
content.value_statement: Generic AI screens often look inconsistent and hard to refine. This skill turns project direction into a structured DESIGN.md that guides Google Stitch, Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to produce a DESIGN.md with atmosphere, color, typography, components, layout, motion, and anti-patterns.
Defines design dials for creativity, density, variance, and motion intent.
Provides explicit banned patterns for generic AI interface output.
Specifies responsive rules for mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop viewports.
Documents motion intent for coding agents that implement exported Stitch designs.
limitations: It does not connect to Google Stitch or call external APIs.
It does not verify the visual output inside Stitch.
It enforces a strong visual taste that may not fit conservative brand systems.
Motion guidance is descriptive because Stitch exports static screens.

use_cases.title: Prepare Stitch Prototypes
use_cases.description: Create a shared DESIGN.md before generating screens in Google Stitch.

use_cases.title: Guide Frontend Implementation
use_cases.description: Convert visual taste into clear rules for implementation after Stitch export.

use_cases.title: Align Early Product Direction
use_cases.description: Set a premium visual direction before a full design system exists.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Design System
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new product idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DESIGN.md for a [product type]. Use creativity 6, density 4, variance 5, and motion 4. Include color roles, typography, layout rules, and banned patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt to Brand Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Use existing brand direction while keeping the skill rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DESIGN.md for [project] with [brand colors] and [audience]. Keep one accent color, avoid generic AI patterns, and make responsive rules explicit.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Stitch Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing visual concept before more screens are generated.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Stitch concept description: [paste description]. Rewrite the design system so the interface feels [adjectives], with clear components, motion intent, and anti-patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Implementation Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff from Stitch design to a coding agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an advanced DESIGN.md for [product] that a coding agent can implement after Stitch export. Include viewport tests, layout rules, component states, and motion constraints.

output_examples.input: A productivity dashboard for agency teams.
output_examples.output: A DESIGN.md direction with balanced density, one calm accent, dashboard-safe typography, asymmetric sections, and strict responsive rules.

output_examples.input: An editorial portfolio for a photographer.
output_examples.output: A visual system with higher creativity, image-led headlines, distinctive typography, restrained color, and clear bans on generic portfolio patterns.

output_examples.input: A fintech onboarding flow for mobile and desktop.
output_examples.output: A design system with conservative motion, trust-focused color roles, form states, touch-target rules, and mobile-first layout guidance.

best_practices: Set creativity, density, variance, and motion before asking for a design system.
Provide the product type, audience, brand constraints, and screens that Stitch should generate.
Review the banned patterns and remove any conflict with your brand requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a security or accessibility compliance review.
Do not accept the default aesthetic when a regulated brand needs stricter rules.
Do not paste sensitive product data into prompts for prototype design work.

faq.question: Does this skill call Google Stitch?
faq.answer: No. It provides design-system instructions for users who already have access to Google Stitch.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written as agent-readable guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it create production code?
faq.answer: No. It creates design guidance that can inform later implementation.

faq.question: Can I change the visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. Adjust the creativity, density, variance, and motion dials before generating the DESIGN.md.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility checks?
faq.answer: It includes responsive and touch-target guidance, but it does not replace an accessibility audit.

faq.question: Why does it ban common fonts and layouts?
faq.answer: The bans help reduce generic AI visual patterns and keep generated screens more distinctive.
